extracted.name: Honey Limeade
extracted.description: A refreshing drink on a hot day. Lime juice and water, sweetened with sugar and honey.
instruction_lines: In a pitcher, combine lime juice, water, sugar and honey. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Chill in refrigerator.
